steps.text: Choose a Quest; lay out its tiles
Place doors, Objectives and tokens as the Quest shows; do its special setup
Add all Wulfsburg Equipment and Zombie cards (#55-62) to their piles, unless the Quest says otherwise
steps.ref: Zombicide: Black Plague - Wulfsburg rulebook (CMON) p.3

steps.text: Shuffle the Zombie cards and the Equipment cards into 2 facedown decks by the board
Split 6 Survivors among the players (new players: 1 each); Wulfsburg adds Theo, Ariane, Morrigan and Karl
Each Survivor: a Dashboard with its ID card, a coloured base on the miniature and the 5 trackers of that colour
Set aside the grey-backed Starting Equipment (Hammer, Mana Blast, Short Bow, 3 Short Swords) and the blue Vault cards (Inferno, Orcish Crossbow)
Wulfsburg starting Equipment (Mana Blast, Short Bow, 2 Short Swords) joins the starting pool
steps.ref: Zombicide: Black Plague - Wulfsburg rulebook (CMON) p.2

steps.text: Share the Starting Equipment as a team, at least 1 card each; Survivors whose Skill lists a weapon also get it
Danger Bar arrow on 0 (blue); trackers on Wound 0 and on the first (blue) Skill; 3 in the reserve slots
Survivor miniatures on the Quest's starting Zone
Each Survivor has 3 Actions per Turn
Zombies' Phase ends with new Zombies in every active Spawn Zone
End Phase: remove all Noise tokens and pass the first player token left
You lose if all Survivors die or too many Necromancers escape
Choose the first player and give them the first player token
